traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

multiattack_text: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

attacks.name: Claws
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
